prompt: Generate a square stone plinth with a full 128x128 base and 64px visible height. Preserve the square-grid top-down oblique projection and fixed ground anchor. Deliver each sprite in a 192x320px frame with local projected ground anchor (96,248). Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.full-base: All four footprint edges fill the cell; no rounded corner gaps or perspective taper.
visualChecks.visible-height: Top/front division shows 64px elevation with upward extension beyond the logical cell.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
